text:
Amy (People Ops): Heads up 1 — Priya told me she's planning parental leave starting 2026-09-07 for ~12 weeks. Need to sort paperwork, payroll top-up, and a short-term backfill. Quick questions: will team hire a contractor or shift duties internally? Also timing for performance review cycle?

Priya: Confirming start 2026-09-07. I'll submit FMLA and opt into Redwood top-up + state benefits. Prefer fully offline first 6 weeks, then email-only for complicating issues. I can prep a 1-page handoff.

Luis (Manager): I can reassign high-priority work and pull someone from adjacent team for triage, but we likely need a 0.5-1.0 FTE contractor for feature parity. Hiring ops: can recruiter-bot start a req? Budget needs sign-off from finance.

recruiter-bot: New req template: "MKTG-ENG temp contractor - parental backfill". Please confirm job owner and duration to auto-fill posting.

Taylor (Finance): Budget question: do you want to use team carryforward or central hiring buffer? Contractor for 12 weeks at 40 hrs/wk estimated cost = $27k. If using central buffer need manager approval + cost center code by 2026-08-15 to secure vendor.

Luis (Manager): I'll route approval. Use cost center 4302-ENG-PL. Please queue vendor options; prefer someone familiar with our infra (previous vendor OK).

Amy (People Ops): Payroll forms: to get Redwood supplement processed, Priya needs to sign and upload the Supplement Election form by payroll cutoff 2026-08-25. people-ops-bot will remind if not uploaded.

people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Supplement Election form due 2026-08-25. FMLA docs pending. Request ID: LR-20260907-77.

Priya: Thanks. I'll upload forms by EOD 2026-08-20. Also note I have a performance review due 2026-09-10 (week 1 of leave). Luis, what's the plan for that?

Luis (Manager): Let's pause the calibrated rating until your return and move feedback to a deferred note. I'll document in the review system: "deferred due to parental leave" and set the review to reopen 4 weeks after return. Priya, if you'd like a short check-in pre-leave we can do 30m next week.

Priya: OK happy with that. Short check-in next Fri works.

Amy (People Ops): Ops checklist I'm adding to this thread:
- Recruiter: post temp req by 2026-06-30
- Finance: hold provisional approval by 2026-08-15
- Priya: upload FMLA + Supplement Election by 2026-08-25
- Luis: set review status to "deferred" before 2026-09-10
- Team: confirm oncall/triage rotations by 2026-08-01

If anyone sees errors call them out. I'll create the formal leave paperwork once forms are uploaded.

Taylor (Finance): Noted. I'll provisionally approve contingent on cost center and vendor selection.

recruiter-bot: Req posted to internal tracker: REQ-PL-2987. Owner: Luis. Vendor outreach scheduled.

Luis (Manager): I'll split coverage across Priya's two squads and block 8hrs of ramp time for the contractor. Priya please add a handoff doc with runbook links.

Priya: Will do. Adding runbook + critical contacts tonight.

Amy (People Ops): Great. Unless objections I'll finalize payroll top-up and document the deferred review workflow tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
